name: Flash Thompson
distinction: A symbiote hero. Flash Thompson is not a Peter Parker variant. The Venom symbiote is bonded to him while he works as a soldier.
summary: Eugene “Flash” Thompson is a classmate of Peter Parker who later becomes Agent Venom. The government pairs him with the Venom symbiote. The powers belong to that bond, not to a spider bite of his own.
firstAppearance: As Flash Thompson, Amazing Fantasy #15 (1962). As Agent Venom, The Amazing Spider-Man #654 (2011).
creators: Stan Lee and Steve Ditko created Flash Thompson. Dan Slott wrote the Agent Venom status quo.
